description: This file contains the Taiwanese Chinese localization (language pack) for Summernote, a WYSIWYG rich text editor. It defines translated strings for various UI components and functionalities within Summernote.

methods.name: Immediately Invoked Function Expression (IIFE)
methods.description: Defines a function that initializes the language pack inside a jQuery plugin scope, extending the existing Summernote language object with Taiwanese Chinese translations.
